PROBLEM: density has no reliable physical identity from composition+cell volume (only 4.7% of rows within 10%, audit/EDA)
DECISION: keep density_implied as an engineered feature, not a substitute target or imputation source

PROBLEM: (K,G,nu) triplet mutually inconsistent with the README's own elastic identity in 28.8%/33.5% of rows
DECISION: predict K and G as primary targets; derive nu and E from the predictions with the isotropic formula (src.data.audit.young_from_KG / _poisson_from_KG)

PROBLEM: band_gap_eV has a point mass at 0 (32.5% of rows, metals) alongside a continuous positive part
DECISION: two-part target: classify is_metal (band_gap==0, verified exact match=True), then regress log1p(band_gap_eV) on the non-metal rows only

PROBLEM: DS5 prices only 40 of the elements appearing in DS1 formulas; coverage is 32.6% of materials
DECISION: compute the cost feature only for fully-covered materials; carry an explicit element_cost_available flag for the rest

PROBLEM: remaining_thickness_mm, fatigue_cycles_millions and Paris constants are each deterministic/near-deterministic functions of other columns
DECISION: keep thick_frac (not remaining_thickness_mm); drop fatigue_cycles_millions and paris_C/paris_m from the model feature list

PROBLEM: 5 columns (was_predicted, warning_lead_months, detected_by, insurance_claim_filed, regulatory_action) are only known after a failure is detected/processed
DECISION: exclude all five from any pre-event feature set (failure occurrence, severity, or LGD-at-event models)

PROBLEM: DS6 has only failure events; there is no asset-level key to DS3 and no confirmed shared population
DECISION: build a case-control table on the explicit assumption that DS3 approximates the at-risk population for DS6's bridge failures; carry the assumption in the table's documentation, not just this notebook

PROBLEM: calendar-month seasonality is real (EDA A5) but computing the month mean over the full sample is a (mild, conventional) look-ahead
DECISION: expose both month_sin/cos (always safe) and daily_return_deseasonalized (full-sample mean, flagged); 06/07 should roll the mean forward if used in a walk-forward backtest
benchmark every model against the category-mean baseline; report when the model does NOT beat it (4 of 5 targets)

PROBLEM: external validation needs a category feature the reference materials don't have
DECISION: fall back to the overall training mean for the missing category-mean feature; report this as a materially harder, more honest test than in-sample CV

PROBLEM: unconstrained tree models were found to be non-monotonic in corrosion_rate (45.6% of rows)
DECISION: add monotonic_cst constraints to both the condition-rating and case-control models; re-verified in 08

PROBLEM: case-control sampling fraction (16.8%) is not the true population failure rate
DECISION: rescale relative_risk_score to the known population rate (1,011 failures / 19 yrs / 5,000 bridges) by mean-matching, not by trusting the raw classifier output

PROBLEM: no explicit $ notional per commodity to convert price-shock % into a $ market-risk number
DECISION: report commodity VaR/ES in % terms only; do not fabricate a notional

PROBLEM: workbook scenario asset IDs (BR-001, ...) do not exist in DS3's own ID scheme
DECISION: apply every scenario by categorical segment (is_metal, material contains 'Steel') instead of by named asset

PROBLEM: location and corrosion_environment turned out to be perfectly deterministic (not just correlated)
DECISION: flag as a simplification opportunity for a production version; left both in for this project since neither model's validity depends on removing the redundancy
